name: agent-wechat
description: Standalone native WeChat daemon, CLI and OpenClaw channel

scripts.release: pnpm build && node scripts/native-release-policy.mjs --check-registry && pnpm changeset publish
scripts.version-packages: pnpm changeset version && node scripts/native-sync-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.native:dev: cargo run --profile test --locked --manifest-path packages/native-client-rust/Cargo.toml -p wechat-simulator --bin wx-dev -- dev
scripts.native:simulator:smoke: cargo build --workspace --profile test --locked --manifest-path packages/native-client-rust/Cargo.toml && node scripts/native-simulator-smoke.mjs
